picks.why: Data-center restrictions won almost everywhere they were on the ballot - 33 passed, voters recalled officials in Piqua and Yukon - though only three projects (2.3 GW) have been delayed so far.
Anthropic open-sources FlashProve, a prototype that lets a user cryptographically verify which model answered, targeting router substitution and token-stream tampering.
Hinton says we might have been better off never building AI, warns of a financial or power blackout incident within two years, and names Altman, Musk and Zuckerberg.
The UK AI minister admits the 400 billion pound AI windfall came from a Google-commissioned report; the government's own estimate is 55 to 140 billion by 2030.
A chip-design lab claims a US open-weight coding record (80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1) for $32M of total R&D, a tenth of the previous leader - all self-reported.
